metadata.description: Sherpa — composable frame/shape/implement/analyze/triage/restory layers, plus the /invoke skill; the user composes the workflow

plugins.name: sherpa
plugins.description: Develop like a sherpa: composable /frame, /shape, /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, build) — plus /analyze, /triage, /restory, and /invoke skills for analyzing, triaging, reconstructing story context, and running pack skills, with bundled codebase-explorer/review/build subagents. The user composes the workflow; nothing persists unless you call /persist or run the opt-in inventory loop. Extend via project packs.
